item.description: I am an Economics Ph.D. student at Boston University. My research interests are in Development Economics, Behavioral Economics, Labor Economics and the Economics of Education. I was formerly a Senior Research Specialist at the Busara Center for Behavioral Economics, Nairobi, Kenya, where I managed Professor Johannes Haushofer (Cornell University)’s academic projects in the fields of Behavioral and Development Economics. I have also worked with researchers such as Edward Miguel (UC Berkeley), Dennis Egger (Oxford) and Toman Barsbai (Bristol).
